title: Vibrant Crispy Jamaican Plantain Fritters
description: Buttery and crispy Jamaican plantain fritters flavored with thyme, perfect for a crowd, and plant-based friendly. Score-fat is replaced with a plant-based alternative.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mashed plantains, flour, thyme, and baking powder.
Add the melted vegan butter, plant-based milk, and salt to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Fry the plantain disks in batches until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters warm and enjoy.
